dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: This is Puspa Café, and I'm the acting manager here.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: If you're a first-time customer, why don't you tell me what your preferences are? Then I can recommend a coffee that will suit your tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Do you like your coffee sweet, or do you prefer it more on the bitter side? Stronger or milder?

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Whatever your preferences, no matter how offbeat, I can make something to your liking.
